title: Department-level Meeting (Town Hall Meeting) No. 2/2026
description: The Office of the Royal Society holds its 2nd department-level Town Hall Meeting to communicate organizational policy and promote staff mental well-being, on

blocks.heading: Department-level Meeting (Town Hall Meeting) No. 2/2026
blocks.imageAlt: News image: Department-level Town Hall Meeting No. 2/2026

paragraphs: The Office of the Royal Society holds a department-level meeting (Town Hall Meeting) No. 2 to communicate organizational policy and promote the mental well-being of personnel, on 26
June 2026, 9:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m., at Novotel Bangkok on Siam Square
In the morning, Associate Professor Dr. Santi Phakdikham, Deputy Secretary-General of the Royal Society,

presided over the opening of the meeting, which also included ethics promotion activities and a lecture on the criteria for state officials receiving property or other benefits in accordance with ethical norms
under Section 128, so that Office of the Royal Society personnel comply with the Office of the Royal Society Code of Ethics
and the Civil Service Code of Ethics, and do not accept any property or other benefits with monetary value
that may affect the performance of their duties; any acceptance exceeding 3,000 baht
must be reported to the head of the agency within 30 days using the form prescribed by the Office of the Public Sector Anti-Corruption Commission (PACC)
Phuphongsak, Secretary-General of the Royal Society,
communicated the policies and direction of the Office of the Royal Society
The afternoon session was a workshop
on "(Mental) Health Close to Home: Recognizing Burnout in Working Life"
led by speakers from To Grow Training, held to promote knowledge and understanding of good mental health,
prevent Burnout Syndrome, and strengthen good relationships between executives and staff in the organization
